patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast background colors are used to delineate distinct content sections, creating strong visual breaks across the page.
Headlines utilize extremely large, bold sans-serif typography for maximum impact, often spanning the full width of the content area.
A vibrant, high-contrast palette of bright lime green, bold red, black, and white is used for section backgrounds and accent elements.
A sticky header containing the brand logo and a primary call-to-action button remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Image and video galleries are presented in dynamic, responsive grids that showcase diverse content examples, often with a playful or 'tools vs. toys' theme.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header where the brand logo and 'Get the app' button become fixed at the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, ensuring persistent navigation. Sections are defined by full-width background colors (white, bright green, red) that span the entire viewport, creating strong visual separation. Content is presented in responsive image and video grids that adapt to different screen sizes. Large, impactful typography is used for headlines to create strong visual hierarchy. The final section features a full-viewport height background with a massive, semi-transparent brand logo, serving as a powerful closing statement and footer.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~5x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for categories and calls to action.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, consistent rounding on buttons and app store badges, with sharp corners on most content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and major section breaks, providing breathing room for large typography and imagery. Content grids are more balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-contrast, full-bleed vibrant colors (lime green, bright red) for entire sections, combined with playful, almost toy-like imagery and massive typographic statements, creates a bold and energetic brand presence that feels more like a creative playground than a typical app marketing page.
